questions.question: Maximum length of the clavicle is measured between:

explanations.a: The conoid tubercle is a landmark on the inferior surface of the clavicle but is not used as the endpoints for maximum clavicular length.
explanations.b: Maximum length of the clavicle is measured as the straight distance between the sternal end and the acromial end.
explanations.c: The mid-shaft and lateral third are not the endpoints used for measuring maximum clavicular length.
explanations.d: The medial and lateral thirds are portions of the shaft and do not represent the anatomical endpoints of the clavicle.

questions.question: Preferred instrument for measuring maximum length of clavicle is:

explanations.a: A sliding caliper is more suitable for measuring smaller linear dimensions such as shaft diameter.
explanations.b: A spreading caliper is generally used for measuring breadth or distances between difficult-to-reach points.
explanations.c: An osteometric board is preferred for measuring the maximum length of a long bone such as the clavicle.
explanations.d: A goniometer is used for measuring angles rather than maximum bone length.

questions.question: Middle shaft diameter of clavicle is measured at:

explanations.a: The lateral one-third is not the standard location for measuring the middle shaft diameter.
explanations.b: The medial one-third is not the standard location for measuring the middle shaft diameter.
explanations.c: Middle shaft diameter is measured at the exact midpoint of the clavicle.
explanations.d: The conoid tubercle is an anatomical landmark and is not used to define the midpoint for shaft diameter measurement.

questions.question: Instrument used to measure middle shaft diameter of clavicle is:

explanations.a: An osteometric board is primarily used to measure the overall length of a bone.
explanations.b: A measuring tape is less suitable for obtaining an accurate diameter of the clavicular shaft.
explanations.c: A sliding caliper is used to measure the diameter or breadth of the clavicular shaft accurately.
explanations.d: A spreading caliper is generally used for measurements between points that are difficult to access with a sliding caliper.

questions.question: Middle curvature angle of clavicle is formed between:

answers.c: Medial half axis and lateral half axis
answers.d: Middle third and lateral third axis

explanations.a: The medial and lateral ends are endpoints of the bone and do not define the middle curvature angle.
explanations.b: The shaft and acromial end do not define the axes used for calculating the middle curvature angle.
explanations.c: The middle curvature angle is formed between the medial half axis and the lateral half axis of the clavicle.
explanations.d: The middle and lateral third axes are not the standard axes used to define the middle curvature angle.

questions.question: Lateral curvature angle of clavicle is measured between:

explanations.a: The medial and middle third axes are not used to define the lateral curvature angle.
explanations.b: The lateral curvature angle is measured between the axes of the middle and lateral thirds of the clavicle.
explanations.c: The sternal end and shaft do not define the specific axes used for this angle.
explanations.d: The acromial end and shaft are not the standard reference axes for measuring the lateral curvature angle.

questions.question: Instrument used to measure curvature angles of clavicle is:

explanations.a: A sliding caliper is used primarily for linear dimensions such as breadth and diameter.
explanations.b: A spreading caliper is used for linear measurements between anatomical landmarks.
explanations.c: A goniometer is used to measure angles and is therefore suitable for measuring clavicular curvature angles.
explanations.d: An osteometric board is used primarily for measuring bone length.

questions.question: Clavicular curvature angles are mainly useful in:

explanations.a: Clavicular curvature angles are not primarily used for determining age.
explanations.b: Bone curvature measurements have no role in identifying blood groups.
explanations.c: Clavicular curvature angles can provide useful anthropological information for sex estimation and population studies.
explanations.d: Although abnormal curvature can have clinical relevance, this is not the primary anthropological application of these measurements.

questions.question: While measuring clavicle length, the curvature of the bone should be:

explanations.a: Following the curvature would measure the curved surface or arc rather than the standard maximum linear length.
explanations.b: For maximum clavicular length, the straight distance between the sternal and acromial ends is measured, ignoring the curvature of the bone.
explanations.c: The curvature is not measured separately when determining maximum clavicular length.
explanations.d: A mathematical correction is not required when the standard straight-line measurement is used.
